g.text: HOW TO READ THIS SHEET (follow the orange numbers)

g.desc: HOW TO READ THIS SHEET (follow the orange numbers)

g.text: [1] B1 panel input -> [2] B2 power stage -> [3] B3 output & battery = the POWER PATH (thick green wires, left to right)

g.desc: [1] B1 panel input -> [2] B2 power stage -> [3] B3 output & battery = the POWER PATH (thick green wires, left to right)

g.text: [4] U1 the brain: read the grey notes inside the symbol - one line per pin

g.desc: [4] U1 the brain: read the grey notes inside the symbol - one line per pin

g.text: [5] B5 input sense (left-top of U1) how the brain SEES the panel

g.desc: [5] B5 input sense (left-top of U1) how the brain SEES the panel

g.text: [6] B6 output sense (right-bottom of U1) how the brain SEES the battery (divider always on: ~56 uA, accepted)

g.desc: [6] B6 output sense (right-bottom of U1) how the brain SEES the battery (divider always on: ~56 uA, accepted)

g.text: [7] B4b chip supplies (right-top of U1) how the brain is POWERED

g.desc: [7] B4b chip supplies (right-top of U1) how the brain is POWERED

g.text: [8] B4a clock / loop / mode / address (left-bottom of U1)

g.desc: [8] B4a clock / loop / mode / address (left-bottom of U1)

g.text: [9] B7 housekeeping [10] B8 I2C door [11] B9 test points, bench set-up, bring-up, test plan

g.desc: [9] B7 housekeeping [10] B8 I2C door [11] B9 test points, bench set-up, bring-up, test plan

g.text: Right-hand columns: full pin table, design numbers, EEPROM settings, open checks, risks.

g.desc: Right-hand columns: full pin table, design numbers, EEPROM settings, open checks, risks.

g.text: CONVENTIONS: wire = real copper you can follow. Same text label = connected (e.g. every 'VIN_S' is one net).

g.desc: CONVENTIONS: wire = real copper you can follow. Same text label = connected (e.g. every 'VIN_S' is one net).

g.text: Ground symbol = the ground plane. Red X on a part = not fitted (DNP). Each block note starts with IN PLAIN WORDS.

g.desc: Ground symbol = the ground plane. Red X on a part = not fitted (DNP). Each block note starts with IN PLAIN WORDS.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#E66E00; stroke-width:0.5400; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: INTVCC 6.35 V LDO (from VIN or EXTVCC>6.4 V)

g.desc: INTVCC 6.35 V LDO (from VIN or EXTVCC>6.4 V)

g.text: 10uF at INTVCC and 10uF at GATEVCC pin.

g.desc: 10uF at INTVCC and 10uF at GATEVCC pin.

g.text: but 305k inside = ~52 uA drain at night.

g.desc: but 305k inside = ~52 uA drain at night.

g.text: LDO33 -> AVDD direct, VDD via 1R (quiet ADC ref).

g.desc: LDO33 -> AVDD direct, VDD via 1R (quiet ADC ref).

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#E66E00; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: IN PLAIN WORDS: the brain's own power

g.desc: IN PLAIN WORDS: the brain's own power

g.text: supply (6.35 V and 3.3 V), and the

g.desc: supply (6.35 V and 3.3 V), and the

g.text: U1 LT8491IUKJ#PBF (I-grade, -40 C guaranteed; same die/package as EUKJ). Footprint: ADI 05-08-1922

g.desc: U1 LT8491IUKJ#PBF (I-grade, -40 C guaranteed; same die/package as EUKJ). Footprint: ADI 05-08-1922

g.text: from the downloaded library, fixed (see notes). Pins are GROUPED by job, not by number - small parts

g.desc: from the downloaded library, fixed (see notes). Pins are GROUPED by job, not by number - small parts

g.text: hang off each pin by wire.

g.desc: hang off each pin by wire.

g.text: Four loops share VC; lowest demand wins: CC (IMON_OUT) | input-I (IMON_IN) | MPPT (FBIN) | CV

g.desc: Four loops share VC; lowest demand wins: CC (IMON_OUT) | input-I (IMON_IN) | MPPT (FBIN) | CV

g.text: EP (pin 65) + GND 55/59/62 -> solid plane, via array under the pad (thermal + noise).

g.desc: EP (pin 65) + GND 55/59/62 -> solid plane, via array under the pad (thermal + noise).

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#E66E00; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: IN PLAIN WORDS: the brain. It measures panel voltage/current and battery voltage/current, keeps

g.desc: IN PLAIN WORDS: the brain. It measures panel voltage/current and battery voltage/current, keeps

g.text: hunting for the panel's sweet spot (MPPT), and stops pushing when the battery is full or too

g.desc: hunting for the panel's sweet spot (MPPT), and stops pushing when the battery is full or too

g.text: hot/cold. Everything around it is its senses.

g.desc: hot/cold. Everything around it is its senses.

g.style: fill:none; stroke:#5A5A5A; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:none; stroke:#0000C2; stroke-width:0.1524; stroke-opacity:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
g.text: B2 WHAT / WHY (the LT8491 is an LT8705 buck-boost controller + MPPT/charger logic; power stage = LT8705 rules)

g.desc: B2 WHAT / WHY (the LT8491 is an LT8705 buck-boost controller + MPPT/charger logic; power stage = LT8705 rules)

g.text: Current path: VIN_S -> M1 -> SW1 -> L1 -> SW2 -> M4 -> VOUT1 -> RSENSE2. M2 / M3 return SW1 / SW2 to ground through R2 (R_SNS_L).

g.desc: Current path: VIN_S -> M1 -> SW1 -> L1 -> SW2 -> M4 -> VOUT1 -> RSENSE2. M2 / M3 return SW1 / SW2 to ground through R2 (R_SNS_L).

g.text: VIN > VBAT : BUCK - M4 held on, M3 off; M1/M2 chop. VIN < VBAT : BOOST - M1 held on, M2 off; M3/M4 chop.

g.desc: VIN > VBAT : BUCK - M4 held on, M3 off; M1/M2 chop. VIN < VBAT : BOOST - M1 held on, M2 off; M3/M4 chop.

g.text: VIN ~ VBAT : 4-switch buck-boost region. All 4 are N-FETs: top FETs (M1, M4) need gate > source -> bootstrap supply:

g.desc: VIN ~ VBAT : 4-switch buck-boost region. All 4 are N-FETs: top FETs (M1, M4) need gate > source -> bootstrap supply:

g.text: when SWx is low, CBx charges from INTVCC through DBx; when SWx swings high, CBx floats up and powers TGx.

g.desc: when SWx is low, CBx charges from INTVCC through DBx; when SWx swings high, CBx floats up and powers TGx.

g.text: R2 47 mR (CSP/CSN): cycle-by-cycle inductor current for the current-mode loop + reverse-current detect (DCM).

g.desc: R2 47 mR (CSP/CSN): cycle-by-cycle inductor current for the current-mode loop + reverse-current detect (DCM).

g.text: RSENSE1 = input current (MPPT + input limit), RSENSE2 = charge current (CC limit + telemetry). Kelvin-route every sense pair.

g.desc: RSENSE1 = input current (MPPT + input limit), RSENSE2 = charge current (CC limit + telemetry). Kelvin-route every sense pair.

g.text: Layout: two hot loops must be tiny - C8/C9 - M1 - M2 - R2 and C12-C15 - M4 - M3 - R2. EP of U1 = star ground.

g.desc: Layout: two hot loops must be tiny - C8/C9 - M1 - M2 - R2 and C12-C15 - M4 - M3 - R2. EP of U1 = star ground.

g.text: FETs: Q1-Q3, M1-M4 = BSZ065N06LS5 60 V logic-level (one part). TSDSON-8: S=1-3 G=4 D=5-8. L1 IHLP-4040 33 uH, Isat 4 A, DCR <= 95 mR.

g.desc: FETs: Q1-Q3, M1-M4 = BSZ065N06LS5 60 V logic-level (one part). TSDSON-8: S=1-3 G=4 D=5-8. L1 IHLP-4040 33 uH, Isat 4 A, DCR <= 95 mR.
